title: Section 29 — Service of foreign summonses — CPC 1908

content.heading: Service of foreign summonses
content.text: Summonses and other processes issued by any Civil or Revenue Court established in any part of India to which the provisions of this Code do not extend, or by any Civil or Revenue Court established or continued by the authority of the Central Government outside India, may be sent to the Courts in the territories to which this Code extends and served as if they were summonses issued by such Courts.
